# AgentAvow

> Is this tool safe for your agent to connect? AgentAvow checks any GitHub repo, MCP server, npm/PyPI/crates package, Docker image, Hugging Face model, or agent skill and answers Safe to connect, Review before you connect, or Do not connect. Every answer comes with a signed trust score (0-100), an adoption score, and the findings behind them. Anyone can recompute the result and verify its Ed25519 signature offline.

## Check a tool
- [Check page](https://agentavow.com/check): paste a repo, package, or MCP server URL
- A2A Agent Cards: paste any A2A Agent Card URL for an answer, findings and a signed attestation, including whether the card's own signature verifies. API: `GET /api/v1/public/scan/a2a?card={url}`
- [Browse the catalog](https://agentavow.com/browse): every tool we've scanned, filterable by answer
- [x402 endpoints](https://agentavow.com/browse?surface=x402): paid x402 endpoints scored from their public listings (the endpoint's code isn't visible), under their own filter only. [How we check x402](https://agentavow.com/docs/x402)
- [ERC-8004 agents](https://agentavow.com/docs/erc8004-agents): check any ERC-8004 agent on Ethereum, Base or BNB Chain; we read its registration and answer for every MCP server and A2A agent it lists. API: `GET /api/v1/public/scan/erc8004/{ethereum|base|bnb}/{agent_id}`. AgentAvow itself is ERC-8004 agent 1178486 on Base (registration: https://agentavow.com/.well-known/agent-registration.json)
- [Public scan API](https://agentavow.com/docs/check-guide): no account needed, e.g. `GET /api/v1/public/scan/{owner}/{repo}` or `/api/v1/public/scan/package/npm/{name}`

## Use it from an agent
- [Get AgentAvow](https://agentavow.com/get): every install path (Claude Code plugin, ChatGPT app, MCP connector, CI, SDK gates)
- [Claude Code plugin](https://agentavow.com/claude-code): checks your MCP servers, dependencies and new installs
- [For teams](https://agentavow.com/teams): CI gating, change alerts, offline verification
- MCP server (streamable HTTP): https://agentavow.com/mcp
- [MCP connector guide](https://agentavow.com/docs/mcp-connector)
- [Auto-scan in Claude Code](https://agentavow.com/docs/auto-scan-claude-code)
- [Gate CI and agents on the answer](https://agentavow.com/docs/gate-on-the-grade)
